## About
The M Shop focuses on BMW and MINI Cooper. We handle maintenance, service and repair out of our shop on Verdugo Rd in Los Angeles.
We work by appointment, so when your car comes in, it gets our attention. We explain what we find, keep you posted along the way, and tell you plainly what your car needs and what it doesn't.
Drivers have given us a 4.8 rating across 113 Google reviews. Call us or send an email to set up a time.

## Services
- BMW and MINI Cooper service: Routine maintenance, service and repair, focused on BMW and MINI Cooper.
- Inspections: Have us look your car over, including used cars you've just bought.
- Suspension and brakes: Suspension setups, brakes and rotors, with a list of next steps for what's coming up.

## FAQ
Q: Do you require an appointment?
A: Yes. We work by appointment, so please call or email ahead to book a time.

Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in BMW and MINI Cooper.

Q: Which days are you closed?
A: We're closed Sunday and Monday, and open Tuesday through Saturday.
